name: Claude Mythos 5.1
short: Anthropic's restricted Mythos variant (1M/128K, $10/$50) for vetted cyber/bio research; same weights as Fable 5.1, TB4 60.9%.
standout: Made for vetted high-risk research — the tier organizations reach for when cyber/bio analysis needs Anthropic’s strictest access controls.
tradeoff: Identical weights to Fable 5.1 but restricted access and top-tier pricing; the only reason to choose it is eligibility for the safety-vetted lane.
